newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker RGI books gain from Avantor shares.
newsitem.headline: Aker RGI books gain from Avantor shares.

text.p: Norwegian industrial holding group Aker RGI ASA said on Friday it had sold 5.84 million, or 35 percent, of the shares in real estate group Avantor ASA.
The stock was sold at 70 crowns per share to give a total sales sum of around 400 million crowns. Aker RGI said it would book a gain of 335 million crowns.
Aker RGI was the main shareholder in Avantor but has reduced its stake down to 15 percent from an original 65 percent.
"The sale is in line with our earlier announced strategy to reduce the number of activities we are engaged in," a statement from the company said.
Aker RGI's three main areas are fishing, offshore and cement and building materials.
